title: The multiplication and unit descend before the inverse
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be flat, surjective and quasi-compact, $V$ a commutative monoid scheme over $X$ (the multiplication, unit, associativity, unit laws and commutativity part of [def-sc-group-scheme]), and $D$ a transport descent datum [def-pd-descent-datum]. Let $q:V\to V_0$ exhibit an effective projection: its square over $p$ is cartesian [def-pc-base-change] and it is transport-invariant. If transport preserves multiplication and unit, then $V_0$ admits a commutative monoid structure. For every $T\to X$, the induced map from $V(T)$ to $V_0(T)$ preserves products and unit. This statement constructs no inverse.

source.place: multiplication and unit descent step, via Stacks Tag 02W0

proof.text: Apply exists_raw_monoid_operations_of_effective_projection to obtain morphisms m and e on V0, together with their multiplication and unit preservation identities. This step constructs operations without any axioms downstairs.

For an arbitrary Y-scheme A and its points a,b,c of V0, pull back A along p. The cover projection is an epimorphism by the Mathlib fpqc EffectiveEpi instance. The cartesian square uniquely lifts each point to V on this cover. Apply the operation identities from step 1 to the associativity, unit and commutativity equations on V (Mathlib MonObj.lift_lift_assoc, lift_comp_one_left, lift_comp_one_right and IsCommMonObj.mul_comm). Their projections are precisely the desired equations on V0 precomposed with the cover. Cancel the epimorphism to establish all four pointwise laws.

Specialize the pointwise unit laws to the universal product projections to obtain the unitor equations, and associativity to the three universal projections to obtain the associator equation. These define MonObj V0 with the chosen m and e. The pointwise commutativity equation at the two universal projections gives the braiding equation defining IsCommMonObj V0. Taking underlying morphisms in the two identities of step 1 gives exactly the two identities in the conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_commMonObj_of_effective_projection {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} [Flat p] [Surjective p] [QuasiCompact p] {V : Over X} [MonObj V] [IsCommMonObj V] (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) {V₀ : Over Y} (qV : V.left ⟶ V₀.left) (hqV : IsPullback qV V.hom V₀.hom p) (hDV : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V), (D.transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ qV = a.left ≫ qV) (hμ : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a b : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V), D.transport f₁ f₂ h (lift a b ≫ μ[V]) = lift (D.transport f₁ f₂ h a) (D.transport f₁ f₂ h b) ≫ μ[V]) (hη : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p), D.transport f₁ f₂ h (toUnit _ ≫ η[V]) = toUnit _ ≫ η[V]) : ∃ M : MonObj V₀, letI := M; IsCommMonObj V₀ ∧ (∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ X) (a b : Over.mk f ⟶ V), (lift a b ≫ μ[V]).left ≫ qV = (lift (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ qV) (by simp only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc, hqV.w] rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w a] rfl) : Over.mk (f ≫ p) ⟶ V₀) (Over.homMk (b.left ≫ qV) (by simp only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc, hqV.w] rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w b] rfl) : Over.mk (f ≫ p) ⟶ V₀) ≫ μ[V₀]).left) ∧ (∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ X), (toUnit (Over.mk f) ≫ η[V]).left ≫ qV = (toUnit (Over.mk (f ≫ p)) ≫ η[V₀]).left)
